entries.name: ThaiCoon
entries.description: Chef Buddy Hatayodom and Chef Wai of Rasik Local Kitchen open a 'Real Thai, No Rules' casual diner built on curry pastes, seafood and hotpot-style rice dishes.

entries.name: Butler
entries.description: Y Work's new-wave diner at Marketplace Thonglor serving comfort classics, oxtail cannelloni and house-made sourdough bagels baked daily.

entries.name: Canopy by Hilton Bangkok Sukhumvit
entries.description: Opened Aug 1 with four new dining concepts at once - Cante, Glint, Luso and SoolHaus - plus a rooftop pool bar.

entries.name: The Clucker
entries.description: The cult Clucking Donut reborn under BTS On Nut, in soft opening with Nashville hot chicken sandos across seven heat levels.

entries.name: The Commons Cloud 11
entries.description: The Commons' long-delayed fourth branch is finally trading, bringing a fresh cluster of independent F&B tenants to Cloud 11.

entries.name: Piscari
entries.description: Mediterranean sharing plates from chef Marc Vasseur on the 23rd floor of Andaz One Bangkok, with an aperitivo bar and a hidden speakeasy.

entries.name: iberry Group noodle counter
entries.description: iberry's chicken-and-bitter-melon noodle concept has become one of CentralWorld's newest queues this week.

entries.name: Chatrium Rawai Phuket
entries.description: Resort opening in August with two dining outlets near Promthep Cape.

entries.name: Basin
entries.description: Mixed-use hub opposite Soi Pridi Banomyong 21 whose cafe, bar and restaurant tenants land mid-2026.

trend_note: Hotels are doing the heavy lifting - Canopy launched four F&B concepts in a single day and Piscari anchors Andaz One Bangkok - while independents keep leaning on craft bread, with house-fermented sourdough bagels now a signature at Butler and across Bangkok's new cafes.
